blocks.content: Course: Learn React Zustand: The Smarter Way to Handle Data
You are going to build a Daily Journal App from scratch.

blocks.alt: A daily journal web app showing a list of journal entries, a search bar at the top, and a dark/light mode toggle button

blocks.content: You will be able to write, edit, and delete journal entries. Search entries in real time as you type. Toggle between light and dark mode. And keep everything saved even after you refresh the page.
That last one is genuinely satisfying. Add some entries, close the tab, come back later and everything is still there waiting for you.
Next, you will see what this course is really about. Click Next Lesson to continue.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
